messages.subject: How to find files?
parts:
Dear Dr. Phil Chalmes,
I am currently studying Multidimensional Computerized Adaptive Testing with mirtCAT (philchalmers.github.io). I have noticed that many examples referenced are not included in the primary documentation file. Could you please provide access to these additional example files? They are essential for my research.

Sincerely,
Amirreza Mehrabi

messages.author: a29b76a7fee2ac43
messages.subject: Re: How to find files?
parts:
I encountered similar problems too (not sure whether it is the same as yours Amirreza). Specifically, clicking on the examples and exercises links for the Jena 2017 workshop at https://github.com/philchalmers/mirtCAT/wiki - nothing happened when I clicked on those links.

Further investigation revealed that the browser (Chrome in this case) appeared to block the traffic because of mixture between secure (https) and non-secure (http) traffic. Here is a screenshot of the console:


So, to download those examples and exercises, I right-clicked the link and choose "Save Link as ..." or copy the address of those links and paste it into another browser tab to download. The browser (Chrome) might still warn you about the downloads but you can choose "Keep" the files.

Hope it helps.

Regards,
Zhao
